basis: The 1860 free schedule's Hamilton pages (image 383) have Solomon Ruse, 61, with Tabitha, Virginia and Levina, all three at Harmony; he is the only Solomon Ruse in the county. His name stands alone on the line, with neither "Emp" nor "Owner", which is how this enumerator writes a holder's own people. "Leesburg", written small just below the line above, is that owner's town, as the page writes towns elsewhere; checked at higher resolution

The 1860 free schedule has Sidney L Hodgson, 49, in the Southern District, the only Hodgson man in the county; his record's birth year (1809) gives 50 or 51, and his death (1870) agrees with the family tree the index is attached to. His name heads eight lines of ditto marks

The 1860 free schedule has Robt W Thomas, 35, at Waterford, with Rebecca J. Thomas; his stone gives 14 Oct 1825, and Rebecca J. Wright Thomas is in the same Lakeview plot, C-60. On this page a hirer is written "employer" with no numbers, and his line carries the numbers. Other lines on the page record hiring, and whether she was hired out to another household is not settled
His record's birth (2 Sep 1808) and his household agree with the 1860 free schedule's Hamilton pages (image 388) and with the 1870 census
The 1860 free schedule's Hamilton pages (image 384) have Elizabeth V. Janney, 52, with Bettie, who is HM0096; the record's 1804 birth would make her 56
The index entry is attached to Asa Moore Janney, 1818-1901, whose dates agree with his record to the day
The 1860 free schedule's Hamilton pages (image 386) have Louisa Ann Keese, 36, the only one in the county; her record's birth (30 Jan 1824) gives 36 exactly
The 1860 free schedule has Landon Jones, 40, with Sarah E. Jones; his stone gives 15 Dec 1819, and Sarah Elizabeth Wynkoop Jones is in the same Lakeview plot, C-41
The 1860 free schedule has Levi James, 34, with Marthe E. James and a son, Paxson James; Martha Ellen Paxson James is in the same Lakeview plot, C-26
